milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because shearing a sheep drops white_wool which the player picks up. The player starts with 0 white_wool, so having at least 1 confirms shearing occurred. inventory_has is preferred over event-based checks because the sheared wool reliably ends up in inventory (auto-collected at close range).

Uses inventory_has with min_count=3 because the player needs to collect enough white_wool for the bed craft (3 wool required for either crafting path). This differentiates from shear_sheep (≥1) by requiring the player to shear multiple sheep and gather all drops. The 3-sheep scene guarantees ≥3 wool is obtainable even with worst-case RNG.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted light_gray_bed ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 beds, so having ≥1 confirms successful crafting. Two valid paths exist: (A) dye wool first then craft bed, or (B) craft white_bed then dye it. Both result in light_gray_bed in inventory.
